story_meta.title: Winnebago Journey 34N 콕핏 · 운전 중 173cm 남성
story_meta.logline: Winnebago Journey 34N 콕핏 후방 3/4 elevated. 실측·차종별 외관 특성 반영.

characters.reference_description: 30대 남성, 신장 173cm, 캐주얼 셔츠와 청바지, 짧은 검은 머리, 운전 자세로 착석

locations.description: Winnebago Journey 34N (2025), Class A 디젤 푸셔, Freightliner XCM chassis. 실측: 전장 10.82m, 폭 2.58m, 전고 4.04m, 실내폭 2.45m, 실내고 2.13m. 콕핏은 앞쪽 캡이 좌우로 감싸는 composite front-end로, 대형 원피스 파노라마 커브드 앞유리(에어로다이내믹 rake)가 특징. 6-way 전동 캡틴 시트 2개(운전·조수). 대시보드에 12.3인치 LCD 인포테인먼트, 디지털 계기판. TRW 틸트/텔레스코픽 스티어링 컬럼.

characters_in_frame.final_role: 173cm man seated in Winnebago Journey 34N driver's 6-way power captain chair, hands on TRW tilt/telescopic steering wheel, upright driving posture, eyes forward toward road

panels.seedance_prompt_fragment: elevated 3/4 rear view of Winnebago Journey 34N Class A diesel pusher motorhome cockpit interior, 173cm man in driving posture in 6-way power captain chair, one-piece curved panoramic windshield, DriveTech dashboard with 12.3-inch touchscreen, cinematic natural midday light

shots.shot_level_seedance_prompt: 6-second static elevated rear 3/4 view of Winnebago Journey 34N Class A diesel pusher motorhome cockpit interior. A 173cm man in casual shirt and jeans sits in the driver's 6-way power captain chair, hands on the TRW tilt/telescopic steering wheel, upright driving posture, eyes forward. Visible: matching passenger captain chair on his right, hard vinyl plank cabin floor, ceiling with recessed LEDs at 2.13m interior height, one-piece curved panoramic windshield ahead receiving soft midday daylight, DriveTech dashboard with 12.3-inch LCD touchscreen and digital instrument cluster. Composite front-end wrapping around the cockpit sides. Camera fixed at 2m height behind and right of driver, focal 28mm wide. Natural daytime lighting, cinematic composition, calm mood. No camera movement.
